textbookText: 55. The component method of vector addition is preferred over the graphical method because it: A) Gives more precise/accurate results using trigonometry rather than drawing to scale B) Works only for two vectors C) Cannot handle negative components D) Avoids using angles entirely
56. Torque (τ = r × F) is maximum when the angle between r and F is: A) 90° (force applied perpendicular to the position vector) B) 0° (force along the position vector) C) 180° D) 45°
57. A vector quantity that represents the rate of change of angular displacement is: A) Angular velocity B) Linear velocity C) Angular momentum D) Torque

58. Which of the following is an example of two vectors being "like" (equal) vectors? A) Same magnitude and same direction, regardless of starting point B) Same magnitude, opposite direction C) Different magnitude, same direction D) Perpendicular vectors of equal magnitude
59. The projection (component) of vector A along vector B is given by: A) A cos θ, where θ is the angle between A and B B) A sin θ C) A × B D) A + B cos θ

60. Extraordinary fact: the cross product is used to define which real-world rotational quantity that determines a spinning top's stability? A) Angular momentum (L = r × p) B) Linear momentum C) Kinetic energy D) Electric field
